educationalGoal: In Liberal Arts in English, students will acquire knowledge of pertinent sociocultural issues both inside and outside Japan. Students will gain awareness of diverse points of view while exploring Japanese and non-Japanese cultures (comparative cultural studies). Further, students will acquire general English language communication skills while developing class presentations and projects.
advice: The class will be conducted using the following topics: Unit 1: Defining Liberal Arts & Introduction to Comparative Cultural Studies Unit 2: Current events and sociocultural topics Unit 3: Overview of critical social problems in Japan and globally Unit 4: Taking action and social responsibility Unit 5: Student projects and presentations Students are expected to actively participate in learning activities. Both Liberal Arts content and English language skills will be developed simultaneously. Students will be challenged to develop their English language skills while: A) comparing their own unique culture to other international cultures; B) being exposed to critical social problems and developing ideas for positive social change. Students will complete regular homework activities, introductory research on social topics and social problems, and develop results-oriented presentations and class projects.
